title: circulatory-autogen-modules directory layout
description: Every level of modules/ and system_models/: the directories and files each may hold, their name patterns, and the rules across levels. tests/test_structure.py walks both trees and checks them against this file; modules/README.md explains it. In a file or directory name, {module_type}, {version}, {instance}, {model} and {category} stand for the enclosing directories' names.

excluded.modules/poiseuille_transport: another session's module in the pre-versions layout; moves to transport/ when that work is committed
excluded.modules/system: holds only system/poiseuille (another session's uncommitted system models); moves to system_models/poiseuille when that work is committed

modules_root.description: The module library: category directories, this schema and the README.

category.description: A physiological grouping (vessels, cardiac, cell, ...), possibly nested (cell/neurons). Holds only subcategories and module_types, no files. A directory is a category when it has no versions/ directory.

module_type.description: One module_type: a directory with versions/. Its report across versions is generated next to it.

versions.description: One directory per version of the module_type.

version.description: One version: the math (CellML component, one config entry, units) and its tests. The version name is the config entry's module_subtype. A supermodule version (module_format supermodule) has no CellML or units of its own.

instances.description: One directory per instance of the version.

instance.description: One parameter set of the version (never different math). Named by its obs_data's obs_data_name; 'default' is the parameters a version has unless a model names another instance.

files.generated_note: Built by tools/build_instance_omex.py (make omex) from the files above and the version's files; not committed. A COMBINE archive for CUFLynx: the flattened model of the version's test network with this instance's parameters as master, the obs_data and params_for_id, and every input incl. the verification config.

risk.description: The joint failure-risk analysis of the version (make risk), committed.

system_models_root.description: Whole models built from the library, grouped in categories. System models are not modules or supermodules.

system_model.description: One model: its vessel array (records name a module_type, a version as module_subtype, and an instance), parameters (which win over the instances'), spec, and circulatory_autogen's original under reference/.

reference.description: circulatory_autogen's original model (its own module names), not checked.

rules.version_is_module_subtype: A version directory's config file has exactly one entry, whose module_type is the module_type directory's name and whose module_subtype is the version directory's name.
rules.spec_files: A version's spec is two files. {module_type}_{version}_verification_config.json holds what the checks run: the keys in spec_keys.verification_config. {module_type}_{version}_tests.yaml holds review and record-keeping: the keys in spec_keys.tests. module_type and version (equal to the directory names) are in both. Any other key, or a key in the wrong file, is an error.
rules.default_instance_exists: The config entry's default_instance names an instance directory of the version.
rules.instance_is_obs_data_name: An instance with an obs_data (and a validation obs_data) has "obs_data_name" equal to the instance directory's name.
rules.unique_directory_names: No category or module_type directory name appears twice in modules/ (the generic names above, version names, which repeat across module_types, and instance names, which name data sets, are exempt).
rules.category_is_not_module_type: No category directory has the name of a module_type.
rules.placement: A module_type sits in the most specific category that covers every context it is used in (not as shallow as possible).
rules.version_names: Versions are named <source>_vXX (e.g. Argus2026_v01); existing module_subtypes (vp, nn_constant, ...) are kept. libcuflynx's vessel-port connection rule reads a module_subtype's first two letters as the inlet and outlet port kinds when they are pp, pv, vp or vv (and exempts names starting nn), so a version name starts with one of those four only when it means that port convention.
rules.system_model_records_resolve: Every record of a system model's vessel array names a (module_type, version) of the library and an instance that version has (records of modules not in this library are listed in the model's spec as known).
